name: What types of toilets are available for replacement?

mainEntity.name: What types of toilets are available for replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: There is a wide variety of toilets available, including gravity-flush models, pressure-assisted toilets, and dual-flush options. You can also choose between one-piece and two-piece designs, different bowl shapes like round or elongated, and various heights, such as standard or comfort height. Specialty toilets like wall-mounted or smart toilets are also options. Our team can help you select the best type based on your bathroom's layout, budget, and personal preferences.
acceptedAnswer.description: Available toilet types include gravity-flush, pressure-assisted, and dual-flush, with options for one-piece, two-piece, and different bowl shapes and heights.
